name: Yollly
pitch: Yollly is a breakfast recipe app (iOS, Android and web). Snap a photo of the ingredients you have and it suggests breakfast recipes; you can browse by diet (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, quick, kids), filter by protein and macros, plan the week and get a shopping list. Free plan available, Premium is $5.99/month.
tone: warm, friendly, practical, short, no hard sell

discovery.topicDescription: People who don't know what to make for breakfast, want quick or healthy breakfast ideas, want to use up ingredients they already have, or are bored of eating the same breakfast every day.
